init_hook: hex_bootstrap_log=$(mktemp) && if ! mix local.hex --if-missing --force > "$hex_bootstrap_log" 2>&1; then if grep -Eq "unsupported_certificate|key_usage_mismatch" "$hex_bootstrap_log"; then mix archive.install github hexpm/hex tag v2.4.2 --force > /dev/null; else cat "$hex_bootstrap_log" >&2; rm -f "$hex_bootstrap_log"; exit 1; fi; fi; rm -f "$hex_bootstrap_log"

rebar_bootstrap_log=$(mktemp) && if ! mix local.rebar --if-missing --force > "$rebar_bootstrap_log" 2>&1; then if grep -Eq "unsupported_certificate|key_usage_mismatch" "$rebar_bootstrap_log"; then echo "[devbox] rebar bootstrap skipped: hex.pm unreachable through TLS interception" >&2; else cat "$rebar_bootstrap_log" >&2; rm -f "$rebar_bootstrap_log"; exit 1; fi; fi; rm -f "$rebar_bootstrap_log"
